transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, my wife is the one who made the appointment. What finally scared her is that I keep hearing things. I hear water running, and men whispering inside the walls when nobody is there. And sometimes I see this dark, wet patch spreading across the hallway floor. Even after I’ve gone over and checked and found out it’s completely dry, I still see it. So, she said I needed to come in.
Did these experiences start while you were drinking heavily or soon after you cut down or stopped drinking?
No, I... I don't drink heavily. I never really have. So it definitely didn't have anything to do with alcohol, or cutting back on it. It just sort of started happening on its own.
Have you used any drugs like methamphetamine, cocaine, cannabis, LSD, or similar substances recently?
No, I haven't used any of those. I don't do drugs at all. I've just been dealing with... well, whatever this is, on my own. No drugs, no alcohol. Just me.
Do you believe someone is trying to harm you or spy on you?

Well, I know it sounds far-fetched... but yes. I'm certain the mold and the wiring in my house have poisoned everything I own. And... I can tell the neighbors are watching me. They're just waiting to see when I mess up again. So, yeah, I do feel like I'm being watched and harmed, just maybe not in the way most people mean.
Have you had any recent head injury, seizure, or serious illness?
No, I haven't. I haven't hit my head or... had any seizures. And no recent serious illnesses, either. Physically, I've been fine.
How long have you been hearing the whispering and seeing the wet patch?

Well, I'd say they started... I don't know, maybe a few months ago? But I can tell you for sure that before all these house problems dragged on and I fell into this deep depression, I never heard those whispers in the walls or saw that wet patch that isn't really there. And I definitely didn't think the neighbors were tracking me. All of that stuff... the voices, the watching... that only showed up after I had already stopped caring about my usual life. It was only after I started feeling like a complete failure every single day that those things started happening.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing the whispers or seeing the wet patch even though you were not feeling depressed?

No, not at all. Like I was just saying... there was never a time where I felt okay but still heard those voices or saw the patches. Before I fell into this, you know, before the house stuff dragged on and I just stopped caring about my life... I never dealt with any of that. The whispers, the neighbors tracking me... it only ever happened after I was already feeling like a complete failure every day. So, no, never a time like that.
